name: deps-update
description: Update project dependencies to safe minor/patch versions, run the tests, and report what changed.
author: jarvis-os

steps.title: Detect the package manager and list outdated dependencies
Apply minor and patch updates only (no major version jumps)
Run the build and the test suite
Report exactly which packages changed version and the test results

validation: the test suite ran and its pass/fail counts are reported
expected_output: changed package list + test pass/fail counts
failure_recovery: if tests fail after the update, revert the change that broke them and report which one
